newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks firm in London trading.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks firm in London trading.

text.p: Japanese stocks nudged higher in London on Friday though a batch of company results and this week's currency turbulence had little impact on a quiet trading session, traders at leading broking houses here said.

The Nikkei 50 index of Japanese stocks traded in London was up 14.04 points or one percent at 1,439.88, extending the Nikkei 225's 2.1 percent rise in Japan earlier today, though dealers said there was little genuine trading activity behind the rise.
"Surprisingly there was not much currency impact, the market absorbed it quite well," said one dealer.
"It was a quick move but the rate is still above 110 and everyone is feeling comfortable with it."
Said another: "Obviously we saw a massive correction yesterday that shocked the markets, now we have the weekend to think about where it will go next."
